Input Monitor 0.1.2

A test core. It shows the four controllers' raw words (key, joy, trig) and
how often each changes, and decodes the Dock's USB keyboard (player 3,
type 4) and mouse (player 4, type 5). See the project's README for the
tests to run.

https://github.com/Miasmark/openfpga-input-monitor
